```typescript
  q?: string
  status?: string
  sortBy?: string
  sortDir?: string
  page?: number
  pageSize?: number
} = {}): Promise<{ episodes: Episode[], totalCount: number }> {
  // Uses select('*', { count: 'exact' }) for total count
  // Uses ilike('title', `%${q}%`) for database-level search

  return { episodes: processedEpisodes, totalCount: count ?? 0 }

```

### API Response Format (route.ts)
```typescript
{
  episodes: processedEpisodes,
  total: result.totalCount,
  page,
  pageSize,
  totalPages: Math.ceil(result.totalCount / pageSize)
}
```

### Pagination Controls (page.tsx)
```tsx
{!loading && episodes.length > 0 && (
  <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between">
    <div>Showing {start} - {end} of {totalCount} episodes</div>
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      <button disabled={currentPage === 0}>Previous</button>
      <span>Page {currentPage + 1} of {totalPages}</span>
      <button disabled={currentPage >= totalPages - 1}>Next</button>
    </div>
  </div>
)}
```
